string-array.name: whats_new_items
string-array.item: NEW: Performance — finds what genuinely slows the device: thermal throttling, storage pressure, background talkers, poor deep sleep
NEW: What slowed my phone? — keeps a daily health record and shows which app install lines up with things getting worse
NEW: Turbo (Shizuku, optional) — trim every app\'s cache and halve animation speed, with a one-tap revert
Reclaim other apps\' caches without Shizuku, straight through the platform
HONEST FIX: Android 14 blocks any app from clearing another app\'s processes. Our "free RAM" button was doing nothing on modern phones, so it now explains that instead of showing a made-up number
Game Boost now reports what actually happened (Do Not Disturb, cache) and no longer runs twice per tap
Modes now really apply notification snoozing and app locking instead of only listing them
